app.name: Worklume
app.trayNote: Closing this window keeps Worklume running from your menu bar or system tray.

unavailable.heading: Worklume can't track time on this device
unavailable.no_data_folder: Your system didn't give Worklume a folder for its data. Contact your IT team.
unavailable.credential_store: Your system keychain is locked or unavailable. Unlock it and Worklume tries again within 30 seconds.
unavailable.in_use: Another copy of Worklume is still closing. Worklume tries again within 30 seconds.
unavailable.outdated: Your time data was saved by a newer version of Worklume. Install the latest version to continue.
unavailable.storage: Worklume couldn't open its encrypted data. It tries again within 30 seconds; contact support if this continues.
unavailable.clock: Worklume couldn't read your computer's clock. Contact support if this continues.

status.pausedLocked: Paused while your screen was locked

timer.unknownTask: A task you can no longer track
timer.noProjects: No projects yet. The projects you can track appear here once you're signed in.

errors.unavailable: Worklume can't track time on this device right now.
errors.unknown_project: That project isn't available to you any more.
errors.unknown_task: That task isn't available to you any more.
errors.unknown_break_policy: That break isn't available any more.
errors.invalid_id: That choice isn't valid. Pick again.
errors.failed: Worklume couldn't record that. Try again; details are in its log.

idle.heading: You were away

idle.paused: The timer paused meanwhile, because your computer slept or your screen was locked. It resumes after you answer, unless you stop it.

reason.consent_declined: You declined screen sharing, so no screenshots are taken.
reason.no_screencast_portal: Your desktop doesn't offer screen sharing to apps.
reason.estimated_from_idle: Measured second by second from when you go idle, rather than from each key press and click.
reason.idle_time_only: Measured from your idle time only.
reason.no_keyboard_mouse_split: Keyboard and mouse aren't counted separately.
reason.idle_inhibitors_count_as_active: While a video or another app keeps your screen awake, you count as active.
reason.gnome_extension_next_login: Starts after you next log in to your desktop.
